events.text_en: Lạc Hà grants the painters of Đàm Ảnh Thành a dry steppe west of the city; Kha Đạm Mặc says it is the right place, where the clouds have nothing to stop them, and keeps a Pool House by the water.
The painter Kha Đạm Mặc walks into the pool of Đàm Ảnh Thành at dusk with his brush; in the morning the brush is floating and he is drowned, with half a sky painted on the silk beside the water.
A painter of Nhàn Vân Quán paints her own reflection too long and cannot take her face back from it; she dies that winter, and the abbey forbids painting a living face onto a scroll.
